rationale: TRAINING-EXPERIMENT.md:40 — generate training data only if the baseline errors are explainable by the training objective. The measured errors (when present) are candidate recall/over-recall or card-content effects, which fine-tuning does not replace.

ROUTING-MEMORY-KNOWLEDGE.md:49 — when capability cards cannot separate real needs, change the card and the clarification interaction first; do not use fine-tuning to hide an unclear product definition.

TRAINING-EXPERIMENT.md:48 — do not claim an improvement when the gain could be catalog memory or a prompt change; without the same-base-model strong-prompt arm there is no adjusted-prompt comparison, so the arm stays blocked and this stop stays provisional.
The two arms differ only in the sales capability card; the same 34 frozen cases were replayed in both, so the delta is a card-content effect, not a corpus or evaluator change.
